Rules Update                                               1

1. Procedure

        1.1 Date of updates
               1.1.1 Season start
                  ●   Each Season will start with the most up-to-date rules all documents will hold a
                      change log and version number the version is equal to the year and the month
                      the version was created
                  ●   Over the course of that season, the Documents/ FAQ will be updated.
                        ● This may be due to spelling mistakes, rules not being written the best they
                            can be, or new rules that have not been foreseen.
               1.1.2 Season end
               At the end of the current season, the Errata/FAQ will be merged into the current rules
               for the upcoming season.

        1.2 Rule changes
               The Buhurt International committees and board with the NO's will oversee the
               Errata/FAQ process as follows:

               1.2.1 Minor Change
               A minor change involves rewording parts of the rules to make them clearer without
               changing how they are applied. The Committees will discuss and rewrite any rules.
               These will be updated in the document on the website, including the date of publication
               and the document version. The updated documents will be sent to every registered
               member on our website. These changes are intended to clarify the rules, not to make
               major alterations.

               1.2.2 Major Change
               For major changes, the Committees will draft the rules and present them to the Buhurt
               International Board, which will then discuss them with the National Organizations (NO).
               These changes will be voted on by the NO.

               Examples of major changes include any modification with a direct impact on:
                  ● Allowed or prohibited techniques.
                  ● Points counting.
                  ● Technical requirements for armor and weapons (length, weight, etc.).
                  ● Any changes that have a financial impact on our members.

        1.3 Feedback
        Rules feedback can be done by all Buhurt International Members on our Website. This is the
        best way to let us know of any concerns. These will then be given to the Marshal Committee to
        look at.




Rules Update                                                                          2

2. Change log
               This will be the change log of this document. It will be updated regularly and we will
                 display what has been removed/added/reworded/formatted. This way we keep
                              transparent communication and clarity about the rules
